Tom Holland Reveals Christopher Nolan's Athena Casting Choice for 'The Odyssey'

Actor Tom Holland shared that he informed actress Zendaya about director Christopher Nolan's preference to cast her as Athena in his upcoming film adaptation of Homer's epic poem, 'The Odyssey'. The movie has received early praise from critics, who describe it as a 'spectacular epic'. The project marks Nolan's foray into adapting ancient Greek literature. This news highlights the intersection of Hollywood and classical literature.
